question: L, M, N, O, P and Q families are living in houses in a row of a colony. Q and O are neighbours of M. L and N are neighbours of P. If O is not the nearest neighbour of L, then who is the nearest neighbour of Q from the given options?
solution:

**Explanation :**

 
• Q and O are neighbours of M. L and N are neighbours of P. If O is not the nearest neighbour of L

Two groups i.e QMO or OMQ and LPN or NPL are formed.
